name: Shoulder Alignment
algorithm: Shoulder Alignment — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes shoulder movement patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Shoulder감지&추적**: Shoulder landmarks (acromion processes, deltoid contours, shoulder line angle) are tracked per frame. The shoulder line provides reference for head-body alignment and upper body posture.

2. **Head-ShoulderCoordination**: Head and shoulder movements are biomechanically coupled — large head rotations involve shoulder contribution, nodding produces subtle shoulder adjustments. The method measures head-shoulder temporal correlation. Face-swap deepfakes that only modify the face may show decoupled head-shoulder dynamics.

3. **Breathing동작감지**: Shoulders rise subtly during inspiration and fall during expiration. The method detects respiratory shoulder motion (0.2-0.33 Hz) as a biological authenticity signal. Deepfake videos that don't model breathing may show shoulders without respiratory motion.

4. **Shoulder-ClothingInteraction**: Shoulder movement should produce corresponding clothing deformation — fabric stretch, fold formation, collar shifts. The method checks shoulder-clothing dynamic coupling. Generated shoulders may show movement without physically correct clothing response.

5. **시간적Shoulder안정성**: In steady posture, shoulder position should be stable with only breathing-related and physiological tremor micro-motion. The method tracks shoulder stability — anomalous shoulder jitter, position drift, or contour instability indicates deepfake generation artifacts at the body-face interface.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through shoulder alignment analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
